body:
The invalid-user-ID verification test used 123, which can equal the factory user ID after PostgreSQL sequences advance. Using the generated ID plus one guarantees that the signed link targets a different user. Both original assertions remain: no Verified event and the account stays unverified.

The candidate contains main 375f56c39a4a492016cf8c9a9b3472904a1b03f5 through a normal merge. Its sole changed test blob and original one-line patch remain identical to the previously reviewed publication. Independent exact-head parity review cleared ad8077914bc6a941ad1b2bda2fc3bf761066252e.

Validation after BIL38 main integration: all six email-verification tests / 16 assertions pass on a new isolated synthetic PostgreSQL database; Pint and diff checks pass. Prior controlled ID123 diagnostics (eight total tests / 28 assertions) remain separate historical evidence, not newly rerun or added to this patch.

No application, assertion, permission, migration or production change. Fresh exact-head CI and then-current-main containment remain required before merge.
